description: SC2R is a three-component pipeline for educational decision support: a predictive component estimating next-assessment success, an integer-programming recourse component generating candidate intervention plans over a discrete action space, and a semantic validation layer using SHACL.
title: SC2R: semantics-constrained counterfactual recourse framework for educational decision support

title: Scaffolding types arranged on a continuum of self-regulation of problem-solving

description: Scanpath theory holds that a scanpath is \"a 'repetitive sequence of saccades and ﬁxations, idiosyncratic to a particular subject [person] and to a particular target pattern'\" and that scanpaths reflect \"the read-out of the internal representation of pictures, the so-called 'cognitive model'\".
title: Scanpath theory of gaze as read-out of a cognitive model

title: Scenario study approach for efficiently interrogating causal contextual moderators of behavioral interventions

description: When selecting non-experimental comparison groups for school-level interventions, researchers should incorporate school-level attributes alongside student characteristics.
title: School-level covariate matching for non-experimental school intervention effects

title: Scoping review methodology (Arksey and O'Malley framework, advanced by Levac et al.)
